title: Marketplace Orders Refund Components and Refund Destinations
content:
**Standard.** A Marketplace Orders return refund is booked per component. The item component is the item price of the returned units less the deductions of the return deductions policy. The original shipping component is refunded only when the return reason is a seller-fault reason and all ordered units are being returned, or when an undeliverable order is refunded for loss or destruction, or for a bad address or refusal when the option's setting for refunding shipping on undeliverable orders is true. The tax component is the order's tax times the share that the refunded item and shipping amounts (before deductions) bear to the order's item subtotal plus shipping. Total refunds on an order never exceed its net paid amount. The refund goes back to the original payment method, except that a return on an order marked as a gift is refunded to the option's gift return refund destination (Northloop gift card balance).

**Retired clause.** The former clause "The funding party is the seller for every return refund and for cancellations; for loss, fulfillment error and granted Northloop Guarantee claims it is the option's liability party." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for who funds a refund.

**One entry per component.** For a given return, each component is booked once: a return already carrying a refund entry of a component is not booked that component again.

## Components in words

- **Item component:** the unit price multiplied by the units refunded, less the restocking fee, the return shipping fee and the late-return deduction withheld, rounded to the cent.
- **Tax component:** the order's sales tax multiplied by the refunded item and shipping amounts before deductions, divided by the order's item subtotal plus shipping charge, rounded to the cent.

## When original shipping is refunded

| Situation | Original shipping refunded |
|---|---|
| seller-fault return reason, all ordered units returned | yes |
| seller-fault return reason, only some units returned | no |
| reason not a seller-fault reason | no |
| undeliverable, lost or destroyed | yes |
| undeliverable, bad address or refused | only where the option's setting is true |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical order of 2 units at USD 40.00 with USD 5.99 shipping and USD 6.88 tax (item subtotal plus shipping USD 85.99):

- Both units returned as defective: item USD 80.00, original shipping USD 5.99, tax 6.88 times 85.99 over 85.99, that is USD 6.88.
- One unit returned as defective: item USD 40.00, no original shipping (not all units), tax 6.88 times 40.00 over 85.99, that is USD 3.20.

superseded_clauses: The funded_by party is the seller for every return refund and for cancellations; for loss, fulfillment error and granted Northloop Guarantee claims it is the option's liability party.
